title: Fumbling in Babel: An Investigation into ChatGPT’s Language Identification Ability

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating ChatGPT's zero- and few-shot language identification capabilities across a custom benchmark of 670 languages (Babel-670) to measure performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.

Analyzing and visualizing language identification F1 scores based on the geographical regions where the languages are primarily spoken, highlighting systemic regional disparities such as the severe lack of support for African languages.

Calculating the correlation between the number of languages using a particular writing system and the model's language identification performance, demonstrating lower accuracy for widely shared scripts like Latin and Arabic compared to unique scripts.
